exampleEn: The frontend calls the API and renders the result.
exampleZh: 前端调用接口并渲染结果。

exampleEn: The backend validates the token before the call.
exampleZh: 服务端在调用前校验令牌。

exampleEn: We split the page into smaller components.
exampleZh: 我们把页面拆成更小的组件。

exampleEn: State management keeps the data flow predictable.
exampleZh: 状态管理让数据流保持可预期。

exampleEn: Hydration attaches the event handlers after the page loads.
exampleZh: 水合在页面加载后接管事件处理。

exampleEn: A hydration mismatch breaks the server rendered markup.
exampleZh: 水合不匹配会破坏服务端渲染的标记。

exampleEn: The parent passes the user name through props.
exampleZh: 父组件通过 props 传递用户名。

exampleEn: Reactive objects update the view automatically.
exampleZh: 响应式对象会自动更新视图。

exampleEn: Use ref when you need to reassign the whole value.
exampleZh: 需要整体重新赋值时使用 ref。

exampleEn: The computed value only recalculates when its source changes.
exampleZh: 计算属性只在依赖变化时重新求值。

exampleEn: A watcher runs side effects when the state changes.
exampleZh: 侦听器在状态变化时执行副作用。

exampleEn: The virtual DOM diff keeps every update cheap.
exampleZh: 虚拟 DOM 的 diff 让每次更新都很廉价。

exampleEn: Server-side rendering gives the crawler the full markup.
exampleZh: 服务端渲染让爬虫拿到完整标记。

exampleEn: The middleware logs every incoming request.
exampleZh: 中间件记录每一个进入的请求。

exampleEn: The controller only maps requests to the service layer.
exampleZh: 控制器只负责把请求映射到服务层。

exampleEn: The service layer holds the business rules.
exampleZh: 服务层承载业务规则。

exampleEn: The repository hides the database behind a simple API.
exampleZh: 仓储层把数据库藏在一个简单接口之后。

exampleEn: Dependency injection lets us test the service in isolation.
exampleZh: 依赖注入让我们可以单独测试服务。

exampleEn: The ORM generates the queries from the model.
exampleZh: ORM 根据模型生成查询语句。

exampleEn: We wrap both updates in one transaction.
exampleZh: 我们把两次更新包进同一个事务。

exampleEn: Idempotency keeps a retried request safe.
exampleZh: 幂等性让重试的请求保持安全。

exampleEn: Rate limiting protects the payment endpoint.
exampleZh: 限流保护支付接口。

exampleEn: Authentication proves who the user is.
exampleZh: 身份认证证明用户是谁。

exampleEn: Authorization decides what the user may do.
exampleZh: 授权决定用户能做什么。

exampleEn: The API returns a list of orders.
exampleZh: 该接口返回一份订单列表。

exampleEn: We expose the order resource as a REST API.
exampleZh: 我们用 REST 接口暴露订单资源。

exampleEn: GraphQL lets the client ask for the exact fields.
exampleZh: GraphQL 让客户端只取需要的字段。

exampleEn: Each endpoint has one clear responsibility.
exampleZh: 每个接口端点只承担一项明确职责。

exampleEn: The payload carries the order items.
exampleZh: 载荷里带着订单条目。

exampleEn: A 200 status code means the request succeeded.
exampleZh: 200 状态码表示请求成功。

exampleEn: The schema rejects a missing required field.
exampleZh: 数据结构约定会拒绝缺失的必填字段。

exampleEn: The payment service calls our webhook after success.
exampleZh: 支付服务在成功后回调我们的网络钩子。

exampleEn: Pagination keeps the list response small.
exampleZh: 分页让列表响应保持精简。

exampleEn: Serialization turns the object into a JSON string.
exampleZh: 序列化把对象转成 JSON 字符串。

exampleEn: The reporting database now runs on a read replica.
exampleZh: 报表数据库现在跑在只读副本上。

exampleEn: The index on the order id speeds up the lookup.
exampleZh: 订单 ID 上的索引加快了查询速度。

exampleEn: Every row needs a primary key.
exampleZh: 每一行都需要一个主键。

exampleEn: The foreign key keeps the order linked to the user.
exampleZh: 外键让订单与用户保持关联。

exampleEn: Normalization removes duplicated user data.
exampleZh: 范式化消除重复的用户数据。

exampleEn: The migration runs during the release window.
exampleZh: 数据迁移在发布窗口内执行。

exampleEn: The slow query scanned the whole table.
exampleZh: 这条慢查询扫了整张表。

exampleEn: A join pulls the user name with the order.
exampleZh: 连接查询把用户名一起带出来。

exampleEn: Sharding split the order table across nodes.
exampleZh: 分库分表把订单表拆到多个节点。

exampleEn: The replica serves read only traffic.
exampleZh: 副本节点承接只读流量。

exampleEn: The deployment finished in four minutes.
exampleZh: 部署在四分钟内完成。

exampleEn: Our CI/CD pipeline runs on every pull request.
exampleZh: 我们的 CI/CD 流水线在每个合并请求上运行。

exampleEn: The container carries the app and its runtime.
exampleZh: 容器带着应用和它的运行时。

exampleEn: Docker keeps the local environment consistent.
exampleZh: Docker 让本地环境保持一致。

exampleEn: Orchestration schedules the container across nodes.
exampleZh: 编排调度把容器分派到各节点。

exampleEn: We did a rollback when the error rate climbed.
exampleZh: 错误率上升时我们做了版本回滚。

exampleEn: Blue-green deployment switches traffic in one step.
exampleZh: 蓝绿部署一步切换流量。

exampleEn: Infrastructure as code makes the setup repeatable.
exampleZh: 基础设施即代码让环境搭建可重复。

exampleEn: The pipeline runs lint, tests and build.
exampleZh: 流水线依次跑 lint、测试和构建。

exampleEn: The build takes about two minutes.
exampleZh: 构建大约需要两分钟。

exampleEn: The artifact is uploaded to the registry.
exampleZh: 构建产物被上传到镜像仓库。

exampleEn: The cache makes the second build much faster.
exampleZh: 缓存让第二次构建快得多。

exampleEn: The runner pulls the latest code and waits.
exampleZh: 执行节点拉取最新代码并等待任务。

exampleEn: The quality gate blocks a failing test.
exampleZh: 质量门禁会拦住失败的测试。

exampleEn: The release went out on Friday.
exampleZh: 版本发布在周五上线。

exampleEn: Version control keeps the history of every change.
exampleZh: 版本控制保存每一次改动的历史。

exampleEn: We started with a monolith and split it later.
exampleZh: 我们从单体架构起步，之后才拆分。

exampleEn: Microservices let teams ship independently.
exampleZh: 微服务让团队可以独立发布。

exampleEn: The domain model names the business concepts.
exampleZh: 领域模型为业务概念命名。

exampleEn: A bounded context owns its own terms.
exampleZh: 限界上下文拥有自己的术语。

exampleEn: Too much coupling makes refactoring risky.
exampleZh: 过度耦合让重构变得危险。

exampleEn: High cohesion keeps a module easy to reason about.
exampleZh: 高内聚让模块易于理解。

exampleEn: The unit test covers the price calculation.
exampleZh: 单元测试覆盖了价格计算。

exampleEn: The integration test hits a real database.
exampleZh: 集成测试连接真实数据库。

exampleEn: The end-to-end test clicks through the checkout.
exampleZh: 端到端测试走完整个下单流程。

exampleEn: The fix caused a regression in the payment flow.
exampleZh: 这个修复引发了支付流程的回归问题。

exampleEn: Coverage tells us which branches are untested.
exampleZh: 覆盖率告诉我们哪些分支没测到。

exampleEn: The whole test suite runs in the pipeline.
exampleZh: 整个测试套件都在流水线里跑。

exampleEn: Observability tells us what the system is doing.
exampleZh: 可观测性告诉我们系统正在做什么。

exampleEn: Tracing follows one request across services.
exampleZh: 链路追踪跟踪一个请求跨越多个服务。

exampleEn: The metrics show a slow response time.
exampleZh: 指标显示响应时间变慢了。

exampleEn: Log aggregation puts every service log in one place.
exampleZh: 日志聚合把所有服务日志集中到一处。

exampleEn: We cut the bundle size by dropping the heavy library.
exampleZh: 我们去掉重依赖，把打包体积压了下来。

exampleEn: Tree shaking removes the unused exports.
exampleZh: 摇树优化移除了没有用到的导出。

exampleEn: Code splitting loads the editor on demand.
exampleZh: 代码分割按需加载编辑器。

exampleEn: Lazy loading keeps the first screen fast.
exampleZh: 懒加载让首屏保持快速。

exampleEn: The LLM writes the draft for the release note.
exampleZh: 大语言模型为发布说明起草内容。

exampleEn: Each token costs a little money.
exampleZh: 每个词元都要花一点成本。

exampleEn: The context window limits how much we can send.
exampleZh: 上下文窗口限制了我们能发送的内容量。

exampleEn: Prompt injection tries to override our rules.
exampleZh: 提示注入试图覆盖我们的规则。

exampleEn: Hallucination makes the model invent a fact.
exampleZh: 模型幻觉会让模型编造事实。

exampleEn: Inference runs on the GPU for every request.
exampleZh: 每次请求都要在 GPU 上做推理。

exampleEn: Fine-tuning adapts the model to our style.
exampleZh: 微调让模型适应我们的风格。

exampleEn: The embedding turns a sentence into numbers.
exampleZh: 嵌入向量把一个句子变成数字。

exampleEn: A clear prompt gets a better answer.
exampleZh: 清晰的提示词能得到更好的回答。

exampleEn: The system prompt sets the role of the assistant.
exampleZh: 系统提示设定助手的角色。

exampleEn: Few-shot examples show the model the format.
exampleZh: 少样本示例向模型展示格式。

exampleEn: The zero-shot prompt worked surprisingly well.
exampleZh: 零样本提示的效果出乎意料地好。

exampleEn: Chain of thought makes the reasoning visible.
exampleZh: 思维链让推理过程变得可见。

exampleEn: The template keeps every report the same shape.
exampleZh: 模板让每份报告保持同样的结构。

exampleEn: A low temperature makes the output stable.
exampleZh: 低采样温度让输出更稳定。

exampleEn: The guardrail blocks harmful output.
exampleZh: 安全护栏会拦截有害输出。

exampleEn: RAG grounds the answer in our own documents.
exampleZh: 检索增强生成让答案基于我们自己的文档。

exampleEn: The vector database stores the embedding of each chunk.
exampleZh: 向量数据库存储每个分块的嵌入向量。

exampleEn: The embedding model must match the search index.
exampleZh: 嵌入模型必须与检索索引一致。

exampleEn: Chunking keeps each piece small enough to retrieve.
exampleZh: 分块让每一段足够小以便检索。

exampleEn: Reranking pushes the best chunks to the top.
exampleZh: 重排序把最好的分块提到前面。

exampleEn: Retrieval runs before the model answers.
exampleZh: 检索发生在模型回答之前。

exampleEn: Our knowledge base holds the product manuals.
exampleZh: 我们的知识库存放产品手册。

exampleEn: Semantic search finds meaning instead of keywords.
exampleZh: 语义检索找的是含义而不是关键词。

exampleEn: Tool calling lets the model query our database.
exampleZh: 工具调用让模型能查询我们的数据库。

exampleEn: Function calling maps the request to a known function.
exampleZh: 函数调用把请求映射到已知函数。

exampleEn: MCP gives the agent a standard way to connect.
exampleZh: 模型上下文协议为智能体提供标准接入方式。

exampleEn: The agent loop runs until the task is done.
exampleZh: 智能体循环一直运行直到任务完成。

exampleEn: The planner breaks the request into steps.
exampleZh: 规划模块把请求拆成步骤。

exampleEn: The executor runs the chosen tool.
exampleZh: 执行模块运行选定的工具。

exampleEn: Memory keeps the earlier decisions in view.
exampleZh: 记忆模块让此前的决策仍在视野内。

exampleEn: The handoff passes the case to a human reviewer.
exampleZh: 任务交接把案例转给人工复核。

exampleEn: We run an eval on every prompt change.
exampleZh: 每次改动提示词我们都跑一次评测。

exampleEn: The benchmark gives us a number to compare.
exampleZh: 基准测试给了我们一个可比较的数字。

exampleEn: The ground truth comes from a careful review.
exampleZh: 真值标注来自细致的人工复核。

exampleEn: The golden dataset never changes between runs.
exampleZh: 黄金数据集在两次运行之间保持不变。

sayAs: L L M as a judge
exampleEn: An LLM-as-a-judge scores the open answers.
exampleZh: 大模型评判为开放式答案打分。

exampleEn: The pass@k metric tells us if the model finds one good path.
exampleZh: pass@k 指标说明模型能否找到一条好路径。

exampleEn: We track the latency of the first token.
exampleZh: 我们跟踪首 token 的延迟。

exampleEn: Cost per call decides which model we can afford.
exampleZh: 单次调用成本决定我们负担得起哪个模型。
